_comment: Production template only. Copy to protected server configuration or translate each value to IIS/app-pool environment variables. Never commit the real production file or credentials. 凭据一律走环境变量，见 docs/security-secrets.md。
_ConnectionSecrets_comment: 凭据不要写进本文件：生产用 IIS 应用池环境变量（LegacyData__Szaipa__ConnectionString / LegacyData__Tongou__ConnectionString / ConnectionStrings__SzaipaAdmin / ConnectionStrings__TongouAdmin），本地用 dotnet user-secrets。见 docs/security-secrets.md。
_SecurityMonitoring_comment: Staff security dashboard. ServerSecurityRoot must be C:\Security (web app reads files only). RequestAuditEnabled=true turns on rolling web-request + staff-login audit; AuditDirectory outside the release root (e.g. C:\Security\audit). IIS app-pool needs Read on C:\Security and Modify ONLY on the unblock_queue / whitelist_edit_queue subfolders.
_IpGeolocation_comment: Staff Dashboard 访客分布按 IP 现场解析省/市。留空则从部署根的 App_Data/security/qqwry.dat 自动找（把 qqwry.dat 放那里即可）；也可显式指定绝对路径。文件缺失时图表降级为空，不报错。
